# Example Coffee

> Independent, first-hand guides to home espresso: choosing and using grinders and machines, written by a barista with 10 years of practice. In English and French.

All guides are free and ad-free; affiliate links are disclosed on each page. Contact: hello@example.com.

## Guides
- [Choosing a burr grinder](https://example.com/guides/burr-grinder/): burr types, grind range and the three models tested for a year.
- [Dialling in espresso](https://example.com/guides/dial-in/): a step-by-step method to adjust dose, grind and time.

## Reference
- [Glossary](https://example.com/glossary/): short definitions of espresso terms.

## Optional
- [Blog](https://example.com/blog/): news and opinion pieces that a model can skip when short on context.
